terra.problem: The passage does not say the trip started on the Jordan’s far bank. Joshua wishes they had stayed on the other side; he does not identify where their trip began.
Saying Achan hid the things like a secret he never expected to explain gives him an expectation the passage does not state, without marking it as a guess.
